title: [E-Documents Core] [Peppol] - Enabling EDI capabilities with E-Documents. Send path (Self-Billed Purchase Invoice/Credit Memo → E-Document)
summary: Enables exporting self-billed purchase invoices and credit memos as Peppol BIS 3.0 e-documents, with automatic type assignment based on vendor self-billing agreements and new manual creation actions on posted purchase pages.
key_points: Adds two new E-Document Type values for self-billed purchase documents to distinguish them from ordinary purchase invoices
Implements automatic type assignment when posting purchase documents if vendor has active self-billing agreement
Creates new self-billed Peppol export codeunit with swapped party roles using vendor as supplier and company as customer
Adds manual actions on Posted Purchase Invoice and Credit Memo pages for creating self-billed e-documents
Includes export validation for participant presence and VAT registration with graceful error logging
